key_insight: Dynamical GKP codes extend measurement-driven quantum error correction to oscillator-based encodings using time-dependent phase-space translation measurements.
engineering_relevance: The two-mode square–hexagonal Floquet construction reduces measurement weight while combining square and hexagonal logical gates, potentially simplifying implementation of the full single-qubit Clifford group.
method: Formulate subsystem GKP codes using scaled symplectic lattices.
Adapt ancestry, detector, and benign-error tools from dynamical qubit codes.
Compute syndrome and code distance using a persistent stabilizer lattice and a bounded inference window.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a theoretical framework illustrated by a two-mode Floquet code and shows that irrational symplectic-overlap measurements reduce to destructive homodyne detection in the single-mode case.
watch_item: The abstract does not report hardware validation or performance under finite squeezing and realistic measurement noise.
